items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember one arranger was [Gene Roland] … he used to play what they call “peck horn” [alto horn], and he wrote like it was arranged for … the Kenton band or something.

ctx.x: But the Town Hall concert, yes. Town Hall concert [October 12, 1962], it was at the rehearsal, there was an arranger. And I remember one arranger was [Gene Roland] … he used to play what they call “peck horn” [alto horn], and he wrote like it was arranged for … the Kenton band or something. Anyway, he arranged, he did not write. He said, “That‟s not what I told him to … orchestrate,” he said, “Cost me $500 and he doesn‟t come up [with it],” blah, blah, blah, and there were things like that. But uh, it was a…
Do you feel like you were influenced by…?
